title: Filing of complaints and appeals with the National Commission
description: The National Commission entertains complaints and appeals under certain conditions

steps.step: Complaints are filed with the National Commission where the value of goods or services exceeds ten crore rupees or as prescribed by the Central Government
Complaints against unfair contracts are filed with the National Commission where the value of goods or services exceeds ten crore rupees
Appeals against orders of any State Commission are filed with the National Commission
Appeals against orders of the Central Authority are filed with the National Commission
